text: Immunology is a discipline that studies the structure, function and immune response rules of the body's immune system, aiming to clarify the mechanisms of immune protection and immune damage, and provide a theoretical basis for the diagnosis, prevention and treatment of infectious diseases, autoimmune diseases, tumors, allergies and other diseases. The course objectives include:Master the composition of the immune system (immune organs, cells, molecules) and the basic principles of immune responses;Understand the occurrence mechanisms of immune-related diseases (such as allergies and autoimmune diseases);Be familiar with the application of immunological techniques in clinical diagnosis (such as HIV antibody detection) and treatment (such as immunotherapy).
